_comment: Oracle for the large_storm scenario. 50 distinct 1-D shapes (sizes 1..50) against one @torch.compile(dynamic=False)-d function, each forcing a fresh recompile -- 49 recompiles total (the first call is the initial compile). Derived from the committed large_storm.log. Every failure is the same size guard, so the analyzer is expected to collapse them into a single 'size' cluster. The perf benchmark inflates the event count at test time by iterating the fixture, so the committed fixture stays under the 500 KB pre-commit ceiling.

expected_clusters.guard_text_example: tensor 'x' size mismatch at index 0. expected 1, actual 2
